Phase Portrait (Limit Cycle Detection)

Row 1: Phase-colored trajectories with direction arrows. Green ● = start, Red ✕ = end. Closed loops = limit cycle. Spirals → origin = stable. Spirals outward = unstable.

MHE Estimator Consistency Analysis

Consistency Verdict BIASED

Estimator bias ≥ 0.5 × RMSE — possible systematic error or model mismatch.

NIS (Normalized Innovation Squared): plot should fluctuate around χ²(n) mean (= number of estimated states). Values consistently above the 95% line indicate over-confidence (P too small); values below the 5% line indicate under-confidence (P too large).
